data.source: Pinterest production API v5 public-pin metrics plus GA4 and first-party database acquisition checks
caveats: Captured about three seconds after the exact 24-hour boundary, superseding a deliberately discarded 23:41:06Z pre-boundary sample.
With zero impressions, the result cannot distinguish the Arm B headline or dealership concept from lack of public distribution.
Before the afternoon publication, the six-Pin static-format cohort had only one total impression and no downstream action; Pinterest v3 and Sandbox are excluded.

GA4 recorded 11 session_start events in the trailing seven days with no Pinterest source, product_click, or affiliate_click event; the first-party database recorded zero product clicks in seven days. Revenue remains unavailable and is null.
